heads.en: The menopause has been broken! The nutritionist has revealed the truth: it is not too much to eat, and many people have come to the middle, often suffering from increased weight; even if they deliberately control their diet, the waist is still vulnerable and the body line is loose. Tsai Tsai Ting Ting, a nurse at the Tsai Hsiao Hsiao Hsiao Hospital in Taipei, points out that menopause changes are not the result of more than just eating, but increase the rate of abdominal fat and obese accumulation as the concentration of female estrogen and male testosterone drops, affecting fat distribution, muscle mass and skin ammunition. 17 minutes ago, he was healthy, he lost his waist in menopause!

heads.en: South Korea exports more than Japan! The South Korean government announced on 19 January that this year’s cumulative export revenues will officially exceed $1 trillion, becoming the fourth country to export $1 trillion annually, after the US, Germany and China. From its initial export of $19 million in 1948, it has grown more than 50,000 times in nearly 80 years, not only to clean up South Korea’s export record, but also to officially cross Japan’s many-year-long failure to break through. Twenty-four minutes ago, South Korea went beyond Japan!
